values.note: City rates (2026): water & electric (20/30/50 amp) $36 a night ($38 in July-August), 30-amp full hookup $38 ($40), 50-amp full hookup $40 ($42). 'Electric Only - One car and one Tent, 20 or 30 amp, shared water' $34 ($36) is not taken as the base. Monthly full hookup $910 / $970, seasonal $3,365 / $3,485, each plus a $5/month transaction charge. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). Campspot adds the park's $5 'Reservation Surcharge' once per stay.

fees.source: https://www.ludington.mi.us/374/Cartier-Park-Campground ('OFF SEASON RATES ... Electric and Water Only 20, 30, and 50 amp Daily $36/night'; 'NIGHTLY RATES JULY & AUGUST ... Full Hook Up: 50 amp ... $42.00 per night'; 'Electric Only One car and one Tent 20 or 30 amp shared water Daily $34/night') + Campspot record of 2026-10-13 ('Reservation Surcharge' $5 once per stay), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/cartier-park-campground (park record read 2026-10-13: '20/30 Amp Full Hook-Up Site' max length 50 ft with 'Pull-Through'; '50 Amp Full Hook-Up Site' 45 ft), re-read 2026-10-22

values.note: Two bathhouses; dishwashing station in the South Bathhouse; shared water source for filling containers; firewood sold at the office.

facilities.source: https://www.ludington.mi.us/374/Cartier-Park-Campground ('At The Site: Shower'; 'A dishwashing station is available in the South Bathhouse ... collect water from a shared water source') + Campspot site types ('Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations recommended, but not required. Booking for the season opens February 1 at 10 AM (2027 season: February 1, 2027). Full payment at booking; a 3-night minimum on holiday weekends, non-refundable.

booking.source: https://www.ludington.mi.us/374/Cartier-Park-Campground ('Reservations for the 2027 camping season will be available online February 1 at 10AM'; 'Reservations recommended, but not required'; 'A minimum of 3 nights is required during holiday weekends and is nonrefundable'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the city's page: season May 1 - Oct 15, 50-amp full hookups with water/sewer, showers, reservable on Campspot; phone matches the Campspot record. Added max rig 50 ft and pull-throughs (Campspot), 3-night holiday minimum, Feb 1 booking opening, wifi. Seasonal rates are posted but the seasonal share is not; nightly sites are sold on Campspot.
